responsibility: Defines the i386 and x86-64 machine constraint language used by GCC’s register allocator, reload/LRA logic, and instruction pattern matching. This file owns the target-specific register constraints, memory/address constraints, immediate/value classes, and explanatory documentation strings for constraints such as legacy integer registers, mask registers, SSE register subsets, address forms, and shift/count constants, serving as the canonical constraint specification companion to the i386 machine descriptions.
